verdict.rationale: Dropbox exposes webhooks that notify external systems of file/folder changes, which developers can use to build custom automation, but there is no native rules engine or 'if this then that' automation UI for end users to define triggers/actions directly within Dropbox. missing for 10: a first-party no-code automation/rules builder, documented trigger-action templates, and evidence of AI-native event-driven workflows beyond raw webhook notifications.
